text:
maria-partnerships: quick roundup 1: vendors sent updated gating notes. H100 image delayed ~10d (firmware RC issue), H200 and B200 still nominal, MI300 driver freeze moved by 3 days, Gaudi image ETA pushed. need to avoid a single joint press; propose staggered announce windows + clear fallback models.

ralph-eng: can we get the exact artifact cut dates? need kernel + base image for certs. if H100 RC regresses we'll fallback to H200-optimized variant.

sophie-marketing: prefer two waves: Wave 1 (H200 + B200) and Wave 2 (H100 + MI300 + Gaudi) ~7-12 days after. keeps press ops and embargo manageable.

jordan-product: SI note 1: confirm integrators can run on staged canaries. some will only validate with full images; will ask top-2 partners for dry-run windows.

chris-legal: we'll add a short vendor addendum re: announcement slip language and embargo handshakes. avoid committing to headline dates until post-triage.

oncall-bot: event "Vendor Gate Triage" created for 2026-03-25 09:30 PT. invites: @maria-partnerships @ralph-eng @sophie-marketing @jordan-product @chris-legal.

maria-partnerships: action list: 1) vendor triage tomorrow 09:30 PT 2) central checklist with per-vendor gate dates + one-line risk 3) recommended announce windows & fallback policy. please drop gate dates in checklist before the call.

ralph-eng: quick smoke update: H200 PASS (batch=32, seq=2048), H100 flaky on large-batch continuous mode, MI300 single-node PASS, Gaudi awaiting image. logs to checklist when available.

sophie-marketing: i'll draft comms for both waves and share embargo windows EOD.

maria-partnerships: thanks1 will consolidate notes and lock wave dates in the triage meeting.
